mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customers (facility_group_id, uuid, email, name, password, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{facilityGroupId}, #{uuid}, #{email}, #{name}, #{password}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
